about:
I am most at home in the backend: APIs, data flow, integrations and tests that describe how the system should actually behave. I am happy to take the frontend too, so I can deliver a feature all the way from database to screen.

I started out with mathematics and computer science at the University of Oslo in 1992. Then the kitchen took over for many years, before I came back to code in 2023.
beforeCode:
Certified chef, head chef at Henie Onstad Senior Center, and owner and manager of Holmestrand Fjordhotell for almost seven years. Before that I was a team leader in a customer service centre.

It taught me to deliver under time pressure, lead people and run a business.

gamesIntro: For students and anyone curious about SQL (in Norwegian)
gamesPageIntro: Optional games for anyone who wants to test their SQL and Python. I made them for the students at Gokstad Akademiet, but they are open to everyone. The games are in Norwegian. Play them in the order below, since each one builds a little on the one before.
progressNote: Your progress is saved only in this browser on this computer. If you switch browser or computer, or clear your browsing data, you start over. Your progress is not sent anywhere.

games.title: Mordet på Hotell Fjordglimt
games.description: A murder at Hotell Fjordglimt in Horten needs solving, and all you have to go on is a database. Ask the right questions in SQL and follow the leads wherever they go. The database runs right in the browser, so there is nothing to install.
games.skills: WHERE · JOIN · LIKE · GROUP BY · subqueries
games.studyFit: Once you have learned SELECT, WHERE and JOIN.

games.title: Millionene som forsvant
games.description: 4.2 million kroner are gone, and all there is to go on is messy raw data. Before you can investigate, you have to build the database yourself: create the tables, fill them and link them together. Only then can the search begin.
games.skills: CREATE TABLE · INSERT · normalisation · foreign keys
games.studyFit: Once you have learned to create tables, normalisation and foreign keys.

games.title: Innbruddet
games.description: The entire member list of a climbing centre in Tønsberg has turned up on a forum, and nobody there shared it. You get access to the database and work in Python to find out what happened, and to make sure it cannot happen again.
games.skills: Python and SQL with mysql.connector · cursor and fetchall · parameters · error handling
games.studyFit: After session 10 of Python + SQL. Part 2 fits after the Flask session.
